description: This file is a code-behind for the TheorySet.aspx page in an ASP.NET Web Forms project. It handles user interactions such as selecting course semesters, adding questions to the database, setting exam details, and navigation between pages, within an online examination system.

classes.name: TheorySet
classes.description: Partial class for the code-behind of the TheorySet.aspx page, managing UI events and database interactions related to theory questions and course selection.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for page load; currently contains commented code for session management.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates course dropdown list based on selected semester.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new question to the theoryQS database table and updates question number.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Sets exam details for the selected course and updates the database.

methods.name: clearB_Click
methods.description: Clears input fields related to questions and marks.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs the user out by redirecting to LoginPage.aspx.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course dropdown list based on the selected semester.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Calculates and sets the question number based on current questions for the selected course.
